common.disclaimer: Note: These results are estimates for informational purposes only. Please consult official sources for legal or medical advice.

ageCalculator.name: Age Calculator
ageCalculator.desc: Calculate your exact age in years, months, days, weeks, and hours with next birthday countdown

faqs.question: How is age calculated exactly?
faqs.answer: We compute the exact difference between your birth date and today, taking into account varying month lengths and leap years.

faqs.question: Is my data kept private?
faqs.answer: Yes! All calculations run entirely in your browser. No dates or personal information are sent to any server.

bmiCalculator.name: BMI Calculator
bmiCalculator.desc: Calculate your Body Mass Index (BMI) and find your healthy weight range

ui.idealRange: Healthy weight range for your height

faqs.question: What is a normal BMI?
faqs.answer: A normal BMI ranges from 18.5 to 24.9. Below 18.5 is underweight, 25-29.9 is overweight, and 30 or higher indicates obesity.

faqs.question: Does BMI apply to athletes?
faqs.answer: BMI is a general guideline. Athletes with high muscle mass may show an elevated BMI despite low body fat.

idealWeight.name: Ideal Weight Calculator
idealWeight.desc: Find your ideal body weight using 4 proven medical formulas

faqs.question: Which formula is most widely used?
faqs.answer: The Devine formula is the medical standard for clinical drug dosages, while the average gives a balanced benchmark.

dailyCalories.name: Daily Calorie Calculator (TDEE & BMR)
dailyCalories.desc: Calculate your daily calorie needs to maintain, lose, or gain weight

faqs.question: What is the difference between BMR and TDEE?
faqs.answer: BMR is the baseline calories needed for essential body functions at rest. TDEE includes daily movement and workouts.

dueDate.name: Pregnancy Due Date Calculator
dueDate.desc: Calculate your estimated due date, gestational age, and pregnancy trimesters

ui.lmpDate: First day of last menstrual period (LMP)

faqs.question: How is the due date computed?
faqs.answer: We use Naegele's rule by adding 280 days (40 weeks) to the first day of your last period, adjusted for your cycle length.

ovulation.name: Ovulation & Fertility Calculator
ovulation.desc: Predict your most fertile days and ovulation date to increase chances of conception

faqs.question: When does ovulation usually occur?
faqs.answer: Ovulation typically occurs around 14 days before the start of the next cycle. The 5 days leading up to ovulation are peak fertility.

loanCalculator.name: Loan & Mortgage Calculator
loanCalculator.desc: Calculate monthly installments, total interest, and full amortization schedule

faqs.question: How is the monthly payment calculated?
faqs.answer: We use standard fixed-rate amortization formulas to compute equal monthly installments split across principal and interest.

zakatCalculator.name: Islamic Zakat Calculator
zakatCalculator.desc: Calculate your Zakat on cash, gold, silver, and business inventory accurately

faqs.question: What is the Nisab threshold?
faqs.answer: Nisab is the minimum threshold of wealth: the value of 85g of pure gold or 595g of pure silver held for one full lunar year.

faqs.question: What is the Zakat rate?
faqs.answer: Zakat is 2.5% (one fortieth) of your total net zakatable assets above the Nisab.

bankInterest.name: Compound Interest Calculator
bankInterest.desc: Calculate returns on deposits, savings, and investments with compound interest

faqs.question: How does compounding work?
faqs.answer: Compound interest earns interest on both your initial deposit and previously accumulated interest, accelerating returns over time.

discountCalculator.name: Discount & Sale Calculator
discountCalculator.desc: Calculate the final discounted price and exact money saved on any purchase

faqs.question: How is the discount calculated?
faqs.answer: Multiply the original price by the discount percentage divided by 100 to get savings, then subtract from original price.

gpaCalculator.name: GPA Calculator (4.0 & 5.0 Scale)
gpaCalculator.desc: Calculate your semester and cumulative GPA on 4.0 or 5.0 scales

faqs.question: How is GPA computed?
faqs.answer: Each grade point is multiplied by course credit hours to get quality points. Total points are divided by total credits.

salaryTax.name: Salary Tax & Net Pay Calculator
salaryTax.desc: Calculate net take-home salary after income tax and social security across countries

faqs.question: Are tax rates up to date?
faqs.answer: Yes, we implement current statutory tax brackets and personal exemptions for each listed country.

currencyConverter.name: Live Currency Converter
currencyConverter.desc: Convert between world currencies with live real-time foreign exchange rates

faqs.question: How often are rates updated?
faqs.answer: Rates are fetched live from global forex data feeds on demand.

dateDifference.name: Date Difference Calculator
dateDifference.desc: Calculate exact time between two dates in years, months, weeks, days, and hours

faqs.question: Does it account for leap years?
faqs.answer: Yes, leap years and specific month day counts are calculated accurately.

countdown.name: Live Event Countdown Timer
countdown.desc: Live real-time ticking countdown in days, hours, minutes, and seconds to any event

ui.eventPassed: This event has already arrived or passed!

faqs.question: Does the countdown tick in real time?
faqs.answer: Yes, it updates every second directly in your browser without refreshing the page.

iddahCalculator.name: Islamic Iddah Calculator
iddahCalculator.desc: Calculate the waiting period for divorced, widowed, or pregnant women per Islamic law

ui.pregnantNote: For pregnant women (whether widowed or divorced), the Iddah ends immediately upon delivery, according to the Quran: 'And for those who are pregnant, their term is until they give birth.'
ui.deathRule: The waiting period for a non-pregnant widow is four lunar months and ten days (~130 days), as ordained in Surah Al-Baqarah (2:234).
ui.divorceRule: The waiting period for a divorced menstruating woman is three complete menstrual cycles (~90 days).

faqs.question: When does a pregnant woman's Iddah end?
faqs.answer: According to Islamic consensus, a pregnant woman's Iddah ends upon delivery regardless of whether she was divorced or widowed.

hijriConverter.name: Hijri & Gregorian Date Converter
hijriConverter.desc: Convert between the Islamic lunar Hijri calendar and the solar Gregorian calendar

faqs.question: How accurate is the Hijri conversion?
faqs.answer: It is based on astronomical Umm al-Qura calculations and may differ by ±1 day depending on local moon sighting.

weightConverter.name: Weight & Mass Unit Converter
weightConverter.desc: Convert between kilograms, grams, pounds, ounces, milligrams, and tons

faqs.question: How many grams are in a pound?
faqs.answer: One international pound (lb) is equal to 453.59237 grams.

lengthConverter.name: Length & Distance Converter
lengthConverter.desc: Convert between meters, centimeters, feet, inches, yards, miles, and cubits

faqs.question: How many centimeters in a foot and inch?
faqs.answer: One foot is 30.48 cm, and one inch is 2.54 cm exactly.

temperatureConverter.name: Temperature Converter
temperatureConverter.desc: Convert between Celsius (°C), Fahrenheit (°F), and Kelvin (K)

faqs.question: What is the formula from Celsius to Fahrenheit?

areaConverter.name: Area & Land Unit Converter
areaConverter.desc: Convert between square meters, hectares, acres, Feddan, Dunum, Qirat, and Sahm

faqs.question: How large is a Feddan and Dunum?
faqs.answer: An Egyptian Feddan is 4,200.83 m² (24 Qirats), and a standard Levant Dunum is 1,000 m².

wordCounter.name: Word & Character Counter
wordCounter.desc: Count words, characters, sentences, paragraphs, and estimate reading/speaking times

ui.placeholder: Type or paste your text here for instant analysis...

faqs.question: How is reading time calculated?
faqs.answer: Based on an average adult silent reading speed of 200 words per minute and 150 words per minute for speaking.

passwordGenerator.name: Strong Password Generator
passwordGenerator.desc: Generate secure, random, high-entropy passwords instantly in your browser

faqs.question: Are passwords stored or transmitted?
faqs.answer: No. Passwords are generated strictly on your device using cryptographic client-side random number generators.

imageCompressor.name: Online Image Compressor
imageCompressor.desc: Compress and reduce JPG, PNG, and WebP image sizes client-side with instant download

ui.dropzoneTitle: Drag & drop an image here or click to browse
ui.dropzoneSubtitle: Supports JPG, PNG, WebP (100% processed securely in your browser)

faqs.question: Is my image uploaded to any server?
faqs.answer: No. Compression occurs locally using HTML5 Canvas API in your browser. Your images never leave your computer.

prayerTimes.name: Daily Prayer Times
prayerTimes.desc: Find accurate prayer times (Fajr, Sunrise, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha) for any city

ui.cityPlaceholder: e.g. Mecca, Riyadh, Cairo, London, New York...
ui.error: Failed to fetch prayer times. Please verify the city name and try again.

faqs.question: Which calculation method is used?
faqs.answer: Calculation uses recognized astronomical authorities and Umm al-Qura standards.

qiblaDirection.name: Qibla Direction & Compass
qiblaDirection.desc: Find the exact direction of the Kaaba in Mecca from anywhere in the world

ui.geoError: Could not access location. Please enter coordinates manually.
ui.instruction: The colored compass needle points towards the Kaaba in Mecca relative to North.

faqs.question: How is the Qibla bearing calculated?
faqs.answer: We compute the great circle forward azimuth between your geographic coordinates and the Kaaba (21.4225°N, 39.8262°E).

fastingMakeupDays.name: Ramadan Fasting Makeup Calculator
fastingMakeupDays.desc: Track missed Ramadan fasts, plan makeup schedule, and calculate completion date

ui.allDone: Congratulations! You have completed all your makeup fasts.
ui.motivation: Aisha (may Allah be pleased with her) said: 'I used to have missed fasts from Ramadan, and I could only make them up in Shaban.'

faqs.question: Must makeup fasts be done consecutively?
faqs.answer: No, it is permissible to make them up consecutively or on separated days according to your capacity before the next Ramadan.
